verdict.rationale: llamafile is built on llama.cpp and ships GPU acceleration for Metal/NVIDIA/AMD/Vulkan alongside CPU inference, which implies the underlying layer-offload mechanism, but the docs pack never explicitly documents a --ngl/n-gpu-layers style partial-offload flag or VRAM-overflow behavior, and community reports show mixed/confused results getting GPU offload to work at all (comm-13 user stuck on CPU despite 8GB VRAM GPU). missing for 10: explicit documentation of partial CPU+GPU layer-offload configuration/flags, confirmation of running models exceeding VRAM via split offload, and hands-on evidence of successful large-model offload beyond basic GPU acceleration.
